source_candidate.apk_size_note: Observed size: 67183124 bytes on preserved copy; SHA-256 matches author-reported digest; Sol has not independently hashed this APK.

fixture.target: X99 recyclable AVD; exact serial requires Sol's issue-visible grant
fixture.user_state: dedicated non-premium test state; confirm the Home DiscountBadge before each case
fixture.first_home_interruption: Premium auto-opens about one second after Home for a non-premium user; dismiss with Android system Back without purchase before each case.
fixture.reset: Force-stop and cold-start before each independent case; each cold start resets show history; do not clear app data or cold-start between the positive case's two clicks.
fixture.interstitial_close: For each shown interstitial, close with its visible close control within 15 seconds of the first visible frame; record show and close timestamps from the recording; otherwise report NOT-RUN.

positive_case.goal: Execute only the positive scenario in qualification/journeys/tinos_demo_gated_interstitial.md. Follow its steps exactly, including Android system Back to return to Home, and do not execute the negative control.

second_click_timing.measure_from: t1: first exact show allowed log timestamp after dismissal
second_click_timing.measure_to: t2: second Direct Message tap timestamp in the native action trace after returning to Home
second_click_timing.visible_duration: D: first ad's visible duration from first visible frame to close-control activation in the recording
second_click_timing.interval_basis: SDK show-history timing starts when shown, not dismissal; the second gate check follows the next ad load (up to 4 seconds); the 5-second margin includes that load and 1-second timestamp uncertainty; D accounts for the first ad's visible duration before t1.
second_click_timing.missed_window_result: NOT-RUN; do not tap after the derived window or count a late or absent denial as a pass

positive_case.missing_revenue_result: FAIL: revenue_event_missing; the revenue outcome is not a pass.
positive_case.hourly_cap_coverage: not covered; this case tests the 20-second minimum interval only

negative_control.goal: Execute only the negative-control scenario in qualification/journeys/tinos_demo_gated_interstitial.md. Follow its steps exactly and report fail_assertion only for the specified intentionally false first-click denial assertion.
negative_control.false_assertion: The first Direct Message feature click must be denied by Tinos rules (NOT_ALLOWED).
negative_control.intended_reason: The first click is allowed, the required revenue observation passes, and only the deliberately false denial assertion fails.
negative_control.adapter: Use the Tinos-specific journey assertions and same-session native Checker evidence. Do not apply the Pocket Actual checker adapter unchanged.

execution.entry_point: Pinned Artemis direct CLI, standalone and collected in the foreground.
execution.runner_command_template: ARTEMIS_TRACES_DIR=<attempt-root>/ledger DATA_ENGINE_DB_PATH=<attempt-root>/ledger/data_engine.db artemis run "<case-goal>" --profile pro --locked-app com.dualix.dualmessenger.webscanner --test-name <case-id> --traces-path <attempt-root>/artemis-traces --device-serial <Sol-granted-exact-serial> --session-id <fresh-UUID> --run-id <same-fresh-UUID> --enable-checker --verification-level final --with-video-recording-tools --standalone
execution.session_policy: Use one fresh UUID for session and run IDs per independent case; preserve that same session for its Checker result and runner-bound final capture.

record_each_attempt: runner SHA, candidate commit SHA, Tinos manifest path/version/digest, and journey digest
APK source commit, package ID, byte size, and SHA-256
target class, exact Sol-granted serial, session/run ID, and attempt kind
exact command, exit status, event order, action/log timestamps, clock offset, and uncertainty
raw timestamped TinosDemo logcat, screen recording, and native traces
Checker verdict, Checker trace identity, and linked runner-bound final-capture identity
revenue line including exact test-unit ID, or the distinct missing-revenue result
cost record; do not begin execution if it requires new spend
cleanup outcome and Sol-verified device release
reporting.interpretation: Require all listed positive events. An allow requires its exact allow log and matching revenue unit; a denial requires its exact gate log after the second tap within the measured 20-second test window. Fill failures are neither. Missing revenue never passes the revenue outcome. Keep the negative control fail_assertion separate from the positive result.

execution_requires: Both independent non-author reviews approve this exact testcase revision.
The signed app-source PASS on CHE-2015 applies to unchanged app sources; verify the author-reported current APK SHA-256 before use because earlier binary evidence does not transfer.
Sol grants an exclusive exact-serial X99 AVD claim in the issue.
The executor verifies the pinned runner and APK identities before use.
The execution report preserves raw evidence and verified cleanup/release.
